events.name: opening-expansion
events.rationale: High-confidence opening boundary with a large positive change in section energy.
Strong rise and net positive local-energy change at an intense landmark.
Very high landmark intensity with high local energy and clear separation from the first impact.

events.name: contrast-passage
events.rationale: High-confidence structural boundary accompanied by a sustained local energy reduction.
Large positive local-energy rise and net change at a high-intensity landmark.
Very high intensity and local energy at a well-separated deterministic landmark.

events.name: low-demand-passage
events.rationale: High-confidence boundary enters an objectively low-demand structural window; section semantics remain allowed there.
Very high energy and maximum landmark intensity support a persistent gameplay energy lift.

events.name: closing-release
events.rationale: High-confidence terminal boundary aligns with a low-demand closing window; no high-impact command is requested.
